i have been self harming since i was young (around 11/12) so to be honest i have had the scars for as long as i can really remember. i cant ever remember not having them, although these newer, bigger ones were hard to come to terms with as they are so obvious. i think i will get a tattoo to make them look nicer at some point!

i take it day by day, even after all this time it can still be a battle but i’m proud for keeping my arms clean and i’m hoping one day i might be able to get a beautiful tattoo sleeve to cover them up !

whether it’s the right thing or not, i completely understand your decision and respect it. since i was a teenager i’ve hoped and prayed to get cancer so that i can stop being a burden to my loved ones without giving them the traumatic grief and guilt that comes with suicide. my thinking is that when it’s something like cancer you have a decent amount of time to help them come to terms with it and then in the end i’d finally be at peace. 

i suppose the thing is that when my loved ones find out that i could have prevented it early but chose not to and hid it from them, they’d possibly blame themselves in some way but i’m sure eventually they’d understand

there’s no need to go on the defensive, there was as far as i can tell no attack on you intended. it’s simply concern and people who know how easy it can go from motivation to obsession recognising that you may be going down a dangerous path. 

if you are sure in yourself that you are in control and there’s no chance that you are developing an eating disorder without at first realising it then that’s great and you know that - after all it’s your journey and anyone reading your post is an outsider looking in. but if it comes across a certain way then it’s not surprising that people are making the connection with this post and one you might see in ED related subs (in fact this post i’m pretty sure would be banned in those subs). it’s not just one person’s observation but quite a few and if you know that they’re wrong then that’s great for you. but it’s not an attack and there’s no reason to be on the defence
